snippet.title: Doki Doki: Amor Fati [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
Upon walking in on Sayori's suicide MC passes out, when he comes to he finds himself a week in the past, with his newfound knowledge he makes it his mission to save Sayori, however fate has other plans for him.
